name: Superman
instructions: Lie straight and face down on the floor or exercise mat, arms fully extended in front of you. This is the starting position.
Simultaneously raise your arms, legs, and chest off of the floor and hold this contraction for 2 seconds. Squeeze your lower back to get the best results, and exhale during this movement.
Slowly begin to lower your arms, legs and chest back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
